title.zh: 副本与 quorum · 一致性和可用性的取舍

description.zh: 把同一份数据存 N 份，写入要等 W 个副本确认，读取要问 R 个副本；当 R + W > N 时读和写问到的副本必有重叠，能读到最新值；可网络一断开，能回应的副本变少，“总能回答”和“答的一定最新”就很难兼得。
description.en: Store the same data N times; a write waits for W replicas to confirm and a read asks R of them; when R + W > N the read and write sets must overlap, so the newest value can be found — but when the network splits, fewer replicas can answer, and “always answers” and “always up to date” become hard to have together.

aliases.en: R plus W greater than N

aliases.zh: 强一致性 最终一致性

aliases.en: why do I read stale data

label.zh: 在不可靠的网络上做出可靠
label.en: Reliability built on an unreliable network

reason.zh: TCP 靠编号、确认和重传在会丢包的链路上拼出可靠字节流；副本系统靠等够 W 个确认在会断开的网络上保证写入——两者都把“没收到确认”当作要处理的常态。
reason.en: TCP builds a reliable byte stream over lossy links with sequence numbers, acknowledgements and retransmission; a replicated store guarantees a write over a network that can split by waiting for W acknowledgements — both treat a missing acknowledgement as normal, not exceptional.
